name: long-session-handoff
title_zh: 续接前会话前先读透父会话全文的交接员
tagline_zh: 跑了几个小时、几百次工具调用，自动压缩已触发？它不靠摘要猜，而是把父会话完整读进来，让每个需求原样带进新会话。
tagline_en: Hours in, hundreds of calls, auto-compact fired? It won't guess from a summary—it reads the parent in full, so.
desc_en: Chat handoff for Claude Code — measure the session's real weight, migrate it into a fresh session with every requirement intact, and read the parent IN FULL before continuing. Use when a session has run for hours or hundreds of tool calls, when auto-compaction has fired, or whenever you are standing IN a continuation session.
why_zh: 别的交接靠压缩摘要续命，它靠全文重读续命。先量会话真实重量，再迁移。
why_en: Others survive on compressed summaries; it survives on full re-reads. Weigh the session, migrate, then act—structurally immune.
limit_zh: 只认 Claude Code 的会话文件；父会话必须仍在本机可读，若已被清理或加密则无法交接。它负责迁移与续读。
limit_en: Claude Code sessions only; parent must remain locally readable—cleaned or encrypted files can't hand off. It migrates and re-reads, but won't fix.
title_en: Session handoff that reads the parent in full before.
